report_topic: Rural and Urban Water Supply Schemes
observations_summary: The audit found that State Water Policies were not revised in line with National Water Policy, and volumetric billing was not achieved. Financial management was ineffective, with significant unutilized funds and poor revenue collection (₹278.20 crore in water charges and ₹69.36 crore in community contribution uncollected). Water supply was inadequate in many locations, with 23 out of 32 test-checked locations receiving less than prescribed norms, and 178 out of 238 audited works experiencing time overruns. Water quality was affected in some areas, and laboratories faced manpower shortages and infrastructure deficiencies, leading to inadequate testing and monitoring.
